home.introP1: The world’s most difficult missions are rarely confined to controlled environments
home.introP2: Industrial facilities, disaster zones, offshore assets, infrastructure sites, extreme-temperature environments and future off-world operations demand machines that can move, perceive, decide and act with greater resilience
home.introP3: Cennzo Robotix is developing WAFEE as a new class of humanoid robotic platform — combining human-compatible form, advanced actuation, intelligent perception, autonomous control and engineered environmental protection
home.introGoal: Put capable machines where human exposure, operational complexity or environmental uncertainty make conventional approaches inefficient or unsafe
home.whyBodyPre: Cennzo Robotix approaches humanoid robotics as a systems-engineering problem. Mechanical design, actuation, power, thermal management, sensing, control, AI, communications, materials and safety cannot be developed independently — so we design WAFEE as
home.whyBodyPost: , where every subsystem contributes to mission performance
home.principle1Desc: Designed around a human-scale form factor so the robot can interact with spaces, tools and infrastructure created for people
home.principle2Desc: Hardware and software are designed to evolve without redesigning the entire platform
home.principle3Desc: Perception, planning and control are integrated to enable increasingly autonomous operation
home.principle4Desc: The platform is being engineered around demanding environmental, thermal, mechanical and operational requirements
home.techMechanicalSummary: High-performance joints, lightweight structural architecture and precision transmission systems
home.techActuationSummary: High-torque electric actuation engineered for dynamic humanoid movement, manipulation and controlled force
home.techPerceptionSummary: Multi-modal sensing combining vision, depth, inertial information, force/torque feedback and environmental sensing
home.techComputeSummary: Onboard computing architecture for perception, planning, control, diagnostics and mission intelligence
home.techPowerSummary: High-density energy storage, intelligent power distribution and protection systems
home.techThermalSummary: Integrated thermal architecture designed to control heat across motors, drives, compute and power electronics
home.techMaterialsSummary: Advanced structural and protective materials selected according to mechanical, thermal, environmental and mission requirements
home.techSoftwareSummary: A layered robotics software stack connecting sensors, perception, planning, control, diagnostics and mission applications
home.appsBody: The first generation of WAFEE applications will focus on practical, measurable problems where robotic deployment can create clear safety, productivity or operational advantages
home.visionP1: Humans have always built tools to go farther, deeper, higher and closer to danger
home.visionP2: The next step is intelligent machines that can do the same with greater persistence, precision and resilience
home.visionP3: Cennzo Robotix is building toward that future

home.ctaBody: We are building intelligent machines for the missions that matter

approach.body: We believe the future of robotics will not be defined by one breakthrough component. It will be defined by system integration

items.title: Engineering First
items.description: We prioritize measurable performance over appearance

items.title: Mission First
items.description: Every subsystem must serve a real operational requirement

items.title: Human Impact
items.description: Technology should reduce danger and expand human capability

items.title: Iterate Fast
items.description: Build, test, measure, learn and improve

items.title: Open Innovation
items.description: The most important breakthroughs often happen across disciplines and organizations

items.title: Responsible Autonomy
items.description: Robots should operate within defined safety boundaries, with traceability and human oversight where required

aboutVm.sideNote: Everything we engineer — every actuator, every model, every line of code — traces back to these two commitments

mission.label: Mission
mission.body: To engineer humanoid robots that extend human presence into environments too dangerous, too remote, or too extreme for the human body — across industry, defense, space, and daily life.
mission.footer: Because the most valuable thing a robot can do is go first.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title1: A world where robots and humanity
vision.body: To redefine the boundaries of human capability through intelligent, adaptive humanoid robots that can perceive, learn, and operate across any environment — from the most challenging conditions on Earth to the frontiers beyond it.

notEnough.label: A powerful motor
notEnough.body: Raw actuation without perception or control is just kinetic energy

notEnough.label: A sophisticated AI model
notEnough.body: Intelligence without a capable body stays trapped in the cloud

notEnough.label: A strong chassis
notEnough.body: Structure without sensing and autonomy is inert material

synthesis.linePre: A useful robot emerges when everything operates as
synthesis.body: Mechanics, electronics, energy, software, intelligence, perception and safety — engineered as a single integrated architecture. That is the philosophy behind WAFEE

systems.name: Mechanical Architecture
systems.intro: A lightweight structural system provides the mechanical foundation for the robot

systems.name: Actuation
systems.intro: Humanoid performance depends on the quality of its joints
systems.note: The platform is being developed around advanced electric motor and transmission technologies, including PMSM/BLDC-class architectures and high-performance servo control

systems.name: Perception
systems.intro: A robot cannot intelligently act without understanding its environment
points: LiDAR where mission requirements justify it
systems.note: Sensor fusion converts raw measurements into a consistent representation of the robot and its environment

systems.name: Compute & AI
systems.intro: Onboard computing supports the full intelligence pipeline of the platform
systems.note: AI is treated as one layer of the robotic system — not a replacement for deterministic safety and control

systems.name: Control
systems.intro: The control stack connects intelligence to physical action
systems.note: This architecture allows high-level intelligence to coexist with fast, deterministic low-level control

systems.name: Power
systems.intro: WAFEE requires a power architecture capable of delivering high instantaneous power while maintaining safety and efficiency

systems.name: Thermal Management
systems.intro: Heat is one of the fundamental engineering constraints in high-performance humanoids
systems.note: The architecture is intended to reduce dependence on conventional exposed fans in mission-critical areas

systems.name: Materials & Protection
points: Carbon-carbon composites for specialized high-temperature zones
Inconel-class nickel alloys for localized high-temperature hardware
systems.note: No single material is expected to solve every environmental requirement. WAFEE uses zoned material architecture based on load, temperature, pressure, corrosion and serviceability

systems.name: Software
systems.intro: WAFEE's software architecture is designed as a modular robotics stack
systems.note: The platform is designed for continuous software evolution without requiring complete hardware redesign

meta.title: WAFEE for the Army — Ground Operations
meta.description: Mission-ready humanoid robots for army logistics, reconnaissance, and hazardous ground operations.

hero.intro: WAFEE moves with the squad — carrying heavy loads, mapping dangerous terrain, and working where people cannot go.
hero.imageAlt: WAFEE humanoid robot in an army field environment

overview.body: Armies operate in conditions machines were never expected to survive — dust, mud, noise, and live fire. WAFEE is engineered to move, perceive, and act alongside personnel in those environments, taking on the tasks that put people at the most risk.

items.name: Load Carriage
items.description: Shouldering rucksacks, ammunition, and supplies across uneven terrain so a squad can keep moving.

items.name: Route Reconnaissance
items.description: Autonomous scouting of roads, buildings, and corridors returns terrain data before boots hit the ground.

items.name: Hazardous Extraction
items.description: Reaching casualties and sensitive payloads in contaminated or active zones where a human cannot go.

items.name: Perimeter Security
items.description: Continuous patrolling of camps and perimeters with thermal perception, day and night.

cta.body: Partner with Cennzo to evaluate WAFEE in your operational environment.

meta.title: WAFEE for Aerospace & Aviation
meta.description: Humanoid robots for aircraft hangars, airport ground operations, and aerospace manufacturing.

hero.intro: From hangar bays to tarmac turnarounds, WAFEE works the ground tasks that keep aircraft in the air.
hero.imageAlt: WAFEE humanoid robot in an aerospace environment

overview.body: Aerospace operations live between minutes on the ground and hours in the air. WAFEE automates inspection, tooling, and cargo flow so crews and technicians can focus on readiness and safety.

items.name: Aircraft Inspection
items.description: Wing-to-tail visual and sensor inspection across hangar bays, feeding structured reports to maintenance teams.

items.name: Cargo & Baggage
items.description: Handling unit load devices, baggage, and spares with precise two-arm manipulation.

items.name: Line Maintenance
items.description: Tooling retrieval, part staging, and repetitive service tasks side-by-side with licensed technicians.

items.name: Ramp Operations
items.description: Guiding and monitoring ground-movement zones with persistent perception and safety awareness.

cta.body: See WAFEE working alongside your hangar and ramp teams.

meta.title: WAFEE for Space — Orbital, Lunar & Deep-Space
meta.description: Humanoid robots for orbital assembly, planetary surface operations, and off-planet logistics.

hero.intro: From the launch pad to the lunar surface, WAFEE is designed for the continuum of space operations — autonomous, modular, and mission-grade.
hero.imageAlt: WAFEE humanoid robot in a space environment

overview.body: Space is the hardest environment we engineer for — vacuum, radiation, and extreme thermal swings. WAFEE modular architecture and autonomous perception extend human capability to stations, habitats, and planetary surfaces.

items.name: Orbital Assembly
items.description: Supporting structure assembly and payload integration in micro-gravity habitats and stations.

items.name: Surface Mobility
items.description: Traversing regolith and undeveloped terrain with terrain-adaptive locomotion and perception.

items.name: Payload Handling
items.description: Moving, docking, and deploying assets within constraint-rich habitats and landers.

items.name: Habitat Operations
items.description: Routine inspection, maintenance, and housekeeping inside pressurized crew habitats.

cta.body: Align WAFEE with your orbital program or surface campaign.

meta.title: WAFEE for Defence & Security
meta.description: Humanoid robots for defence, homeland security, and critical infrastructure protection.

hero.intro: WAFEE stands by for defence and security operations — guarding installations, clearing hazards, and preserving human life.
hero.imageAlt: WAFEE humanoid robot in a defence environment

overview.body: WAFEE assumes the highest-risk roles first — patrolling perimeters, investigating threats, and operating in chemical or radiological environments where humans are quickly exhausted by protective limits.

items.name: Installation Protection
items.description: Autonomous patrol and threat perception for bases, depots, and critical infrastructure.

items.name: Hazard Clearing
items.description: Investigating suspicious objects and IED-adjacent zones from a safe standoff.

items.name: Chemical & Radiological
items.description: Operating in CBRN and radiological environments where protective limits bind human crews.

items.name: Emergency Response
items.description: Rescue, firefighting support, and casualty evacuation in collapsed or burning structures.

cta.body: Talk to Cennzo about WAFEE in your defence programme.
